summary: RE-REVIEW after the rebase onto 4144157 (#956 + #958 merged). The pin at 270f0e5 is void and its record is deleted in this same commit. REBASE INTEGRITY PROVEN, not assumed: I stripped blob-hash and hunk-offset lines from both diffs and compared the 170 changed content lines directly — BYTE-IDENTICAL to the diff I pinned. No file overlap with what landed (#957 touches oms/service.py; #958 touched strategy_core, services/schwab_1m_v2_bot.py and v2_flip_entry_ownership.py; #956 touched ops/health and scripts). THE CAUSE REMAINS SETTLED BY THE OPERATOR RATHER THAN BY INFERENCE: he placed a BDRX order by hand in the Webull UI and got the human-readable form — 'This symbol is restricted to closing orders only' — which is what CAN_NOT_CREATE_A_OPEN_ORDER (http 417) means. Population re-confirmed: exactly TWO symbols in all history, WHLR (2026-08-28) and BDRX (2026-09-11, eight attempts 11:39-12:14 with the price falling 1.3647 -> 1.2273), and NEITHER has ever filled on live:orb on any day. Alternatives ruled out by measurement, not argument: ORDER SHAPE identical (rejected BDRX and accepted FTFT were both STOP_LIMIT qty 1 day); PRICE refuted at every band (live:orb filled 107 buys under  and 14 STOP_LIMIT buys under .50); ACCOUNT/VENUE STATE refuted by timing (FTFT FILLED on the same Webull account at 12:02, inside the BDRX rejection window). THE SAFETY PROPERTY IS PINNED ON THE REBASED HEAD: 'closing orders only' means Webull still accepts SELLS, so the latch must suppress OPENS ONLY — a wholesale symbol latch while holding a position would block our own exit, strictly worse than the rejects it prevents. Focused suites 55 passed; ruff clean. Mutations re-verified on the original head and unchanged by a byte-identical rebase: latch also blocks closes -> test_a_rejected_close_can_never_create_the_open_only_latch RED; drop the CAN_NOT_CREATE_A_OPEN_ORDER code -> 3 controls RED; drop the 'restricted to closing orders only' UI wording -> 1 control RED; disable the WHOLE transient exclude tuple -> 2 controls RED including test_429_veto_wins_even_with_a_not_tradable_substring, so the operator's 2026-07-24 conservatism survives intact. Controlled full unit pair vs the NEW base 4144157: base 46 failed/3676 passed, head 46 failed/3682 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, compared as sorted sets. Ancestor test PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. Cost context unchanged: ZERO dollars — Schwab also refuses BDRX, so there was never a trade to lose on either broker; this is noise and reject-ceiling pressure and correctly sits last in the queue.
